Well, the article touched a little bit on how terrible ads are in the sense that they are annoying, but there's something else here that I didn't see them cover: the influence.

Publishers who rely on advertising inherently begin to tailor their content to conform to the likeness of the advertisers. If you're a newspaper that gets funded up and down by Microsoft, writing something "critical" about one of their products can doom your business, even if it the information presented had logical reasoning. It's a concept that isn't exactly the same as creating click bait to keep general sales numbers up.

That's why I appreciate and support independent news organizations – without them, all media quite literally would become sheep and nothing more than a PR machine for corporations.
